title: Sign encoding under coordinate complementation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a vector of length $n$ over the two-element field, and let $i$ be one of its coordinates. The sign encoding of the vector obtained by complementing coordinate $i$ is the negative of the sign encoding of the original $i$th coordinate.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a length-$n$ vector over the two-element field
$i$ is a coordinate in the index set of size $n$
